title: CERN 反質子減速器~CERN Antiproton Decelerator
focus: 反質子產生、逐平台減速、隨機與電子冷卻、微安培束流診斷、極高真空與 ELENA 100 keV 送束~Antiproton production, plateau-by-plateau deceleration, stochastic and electron cooling, microampere diagnostics, extreme-high vacuum and ELENA 100 keV delivery
summary: 以 26 GeV/c 質子打銥靶、在 3.57 GeV/c 收集反質子為起點，理解 AD 如何把它們逐平台減速到 100 MeV/c，再由周長 30.4 m 的 ELENA 降到 100 keV，並把隨機冷卻、電子冷卻、Schottky 診斷、極高真空與效率鏈整合成可交接給 ALPHA、AEgIS、BASE 等實驗的低能反物質工程。~Starting from 26 GeV/c protons on an iridium target and antiproton collection at 3.57 GeV/c, see how the AD decelerates them plateau by plateau to 100 MeV/c and the 30.4 m ELENA ring takes them to 100 keV, then integrate stochastic and electron cooling, Schottky diagnostics, extreme-high vacuum and the efficiency chain into low-energy antimatter engineering handed to experiments such as ALPHA, AEgIS and BASE.

units.anchor: 銥靶與磁喇叭~Iridium target and magnetic horn
units.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額~Antiproton production, collection and yield
units.mechanism: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。~Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference. Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious.
units.model: p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。產額：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷ 顆 ÷ 1.5×10¹³ 顆質子 ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶。磁喇叭假設電流 400 kA，半徑 2 cm 處 B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T，對 Bρ = 11.9 T·m 的 3.57 GeV/c 粒子提供強聚焦。~The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Yield: about 5×10⁷ antiprotons injected into the AD ÷ 1.5×10¹³ protons ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶. Assuming a 400 kA horn current, the field at r = 2 cm is B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T, strong focusing for 3.57 GeV/c particles with Bρ = 11.9 T·m.
units.verify: 以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。~Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term.
units.failure: 靶材在多年脈衝熱衝擊下出現內部裂紋與密度降低，或質子束點偏離靶心，產額逐漸下降 10–30% 而不易察覺；磁喇叭導體疲勞斷裂則使聚焦消失，捕獲數驟降到原本的一小部分，所有反物質實驗同時停擺。~Years of pulsed thermal shock crack the target internally and lower its density, or the proton spot drifts off centre, and the yield sinks by 10–30% unnoticed; a fatigue fracture in the horn conductor removes the focusing, capture collapses to a small fraction of normal, and every antimatter experiment stops at once.
units.misconception: 反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。~Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.

units.anchor: 動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c~Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c
units.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長~Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth
units.mechanism: AD 是倒著運轉的同步加速器：磁場與射頻頻率同步下降，把反質子由 3.57 GeV/c 依序減到 2 GeV/c、300 MeV/c 與 100 MeV/c。加速器以動量描述粒子，因為磁剛度 Bρ 正比於動量；實驗端則關心動能。減速時幾何發射度按 1/(βγ) 反向增長、相對動量分散也變大，就像加速時的絕熱阻尼倒過來；若不在平台上冷卻，束流會在減速途中撐滿孔徑而流失。射頻系統還必須追蹤速度由 0.97c 降到 0.1c 的大幅頻率變化。~The AD is a synchrotron run in reverse: field and RF frequency fall together, taking antiprotons from 3.57 GeV/c to 2 GeV/c, 300 MeV/c and 100 MeV/c. Accelerator physicists describe particles by momentum because magnetic rigidity Bρ is proportional to it, while experiments care about kinetic energy. During deceleration geometric emittance grows as 1/(βγ) and relative momentum spread widens, adiabatic damping run backwards; without cooling on the plateaus the beam would fill the aperture and be lost on the way down. The RF system must also follow the large frequency swing as speed drops from 0.97c to 0.1c.
units.model: 3.57 GeV/c：E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV，動能 2.75 GeV，β = 0.967；100 MeV/c：動能 5.31 MeV，β = 0.106。βγ 比 = 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7，不冷卻時 5 π mm·mrad 會長到約 179 π mm·mrad。Bρ 由 11.91 降到 0.334 T·m；周長 182.4 m 時迴轉頻率由 1.59 MHz 降到 0.174 MHz，射頻須涵蓋約 9:1 的頻率範圍。~At 3.57 GeV/c, E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV, kinetic energy 2.75 GeV and β = 0.967; at 100 MeV/c the kinetic energy is 5.31 MeV and β = 0.106. The βγ ratio is 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7, so without cooling 5 π mm·mrad would grow to about 179 π mm·mrad. Bρ falls from 11.91 to 0.334 T·m, and for a 182.4 m circumference the revolution frequency falls from 1.59 MHz to 0.174 MHz, so the RF must span about 9:1 in frequency.
units.verify: 在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。~On each plateau measure momentum spread and intensity from the Schottky spectrum and emittance with scanners, comparing with the βγ scaling; log the field and RF-frequency programmes side by side and trim the RF frequency on the plateau to check that the mean radial position is centred, quantifying the field–frequency tracking error.
units.failure: 射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失；低場時剩磁與渦電流的相對影響變大，常是 100 MeV/c 平台損失的根源。~A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down; at low field remanence and eddy currents matter relatively more and often cause losses on the 100 MeV/c plateau.
units.misconception: 動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。~An antiproton at 100 MeV/c has 100 MeV of kinetic energy.

units.anchor: 隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器~Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers
units.title: 隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間~Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time
units.mechanism: 在 3.57 與 2 GeV/c 的高動量平台，AD 使用隨機冷卻：拾取電極量測束流某一取樣片段的平均位置或動量偏差，訊號經寬頻放大後沿環的弦線捷徑傳送，在同一批粒子抵達踢擊器時施加修正。每次修正只作用在約 1/(2W) 時間片內粒子的平均值，粒子數越少、頻寬越寬，冷卻越快；這是 van der Meer 為 SppS 對撞機累積反質子所發明的技術。放大器熱雜訊與粒子在拾取器到踢擊器之間混合不足，都會抵消冷卻效果。~On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive. Each correction acts only on the average of the particles within a time slice of about 1/(2W), so fewer particles and wider bandwidth cool faster; van der Meer invented the technique to accumulate antiprotons for the SppS collider. Amplifier thermal noise and poor mixing between pickup and kicker both erode the cooling.
units.model: 最佳增益下冷卻率 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U))，W 為頻寬、N 為粒子數、M 為混合因子、U 為雜訊對訊號比。假設 W = 0.75 GHz、N = 5×10⁷：理想（M + U = 1）τ ≈ 5×10⁷/7.5×10⁸ ≈ 0.067 s；假設 M + U = 50，振幅冷卻 τ ≈ 3.3 s，發射度 e 折時間約 1.7 s；由 200 降到 4 π mm·mrad 需 ln(50) ≈ 3.9 個 e 折，約 6.5 s。~At optimum gain the cooling rate is 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U)), with W the bandwidth, N the particle number, M the mixing factor and U the noise-to-signal ratio. Assuming W = 0.75 GHz and N = 5×10⁷, the ideal (M + U = 1) gives τ ≈ 5×10⁷/7.5×10⁸ ≈ 0.067 s; assuming M + U = 50, amplitude cooling takes τ ≈ 3.3 s and the emittance e-folding about 1.7 s, so going from 200 to 4 π mm·mrad needs ln(50) ≈ 3.9 e-foldings, about 6.5 s.
units.verify: 開迴路量測拾取器到踢擊器的傳遞函數（增益與相位對頻率），確認整個頻帶內相位正確；閉迴路時以 Schottky 頻譜寬度隨時間縮小量測冷卻速率並與模型 τ 比較；改變增益找出冷卻最快點，用以反推 M + U 的實際值。~Measure the open-loop pickup-to-kicker transfer function (gain and phase versus frequency) to confirm correct phase across the band; in closed loop measure the cooling rate from the shrinking Schottky width over time and compare with the model τ; vary the gain to find the fastest cooling and infer the actual M + U.
units.failure: 延遲線匹配誤差使部分頻帶相位偏移超過 90° 時，該頻帶從冷卻變成加熱，Schottky 頻譜邊緣反而變寬；前級低溫放大器雜訊上升則冷卻時間拉長，循環被迫延長，每小時送出的反質子數下降。~A delay-matching error that shifts phase by more than 90° in part of the band turns cooling into heating there, and the Schottky spectrum widens at its edges; a rise in front-end cryogenic amplifier noise lengthens cooling, the cycle must be stretched, and antiprotons delivered per hour fall.
units.misconception: 隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。~Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually.

units.anchor: 電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極~Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector
units.title: 電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配~Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus
units.mechanism: 在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。速度匹配要求電子的 γ 與反質子相同，即電子動能 T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec²；導引螺線管把電子約束成磁化的冷電子束。冷卻力在相對速度小時最強，所以電子冷卻擅長把已預冷的束流壓到極小的發射度與動量分散。~On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions; the electron beam is continuously renewed and most of its energy is recovered in a collector. Velocity matching requires the same γ, so the electron kinetic energy is T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec², and a guiding solenoid keeps the electrons as a cold magnetized beam. The cooling force is strongest at small relative velocity, so electron cooling excels at squeezing a pre-cooled beam to tiny emittance and momentum spread.
units.model: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV。300 MeV/c 時 γ = 1.0499，T_e ≈ 25.5 keV；100 MeV/c 時 γ = 1.00566，T_e ≈ 2.89 keV。ELENA 的 650 keV 中間平台需 354 eV 電子、100 keV 末端只需 54.5 eV。若在 2 GeV/c 平台使用，T_e 需約 692 keV，高壓與電子槍尺度都不合理，這正是高動量平台改用隨機冷卻的原因。~T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV. At 300 MeV/c, γ = 1.0499 and T_e ≈ 25.5 keV; at 100 MeV/c, γ = 1.00566 and T_e ≈ 2.89 keV. ELENA's 650 keV intermediate plateau needs 354 eV electrons and its 100 keV end only 54.5 eV. Using it on the 2 GeV/c plateau would require T_e ≈ 692 keV, an impractical high voltage and gun scale, which is why high-momentum plateaus use stochastic cooling.
units.verify: 掃描電子槍高壓，量測反質子 Schottky 頻譜中心被電子拖曳的頻率位移，以拖曳為零的電壓定出速度匹配點，並與 (γ − 1)m_ec² 加上空間電荷電位修正的計算值比較；冷卻後以 Schottky 寬度與發射度量測確認達到 Δp/p ≈ 10⁻⁴ 與次 π mm·mrad 的發射度。~Scan the gun high voltage and measure the drag-induced frequency shift of the antiproton Schottky centre, defining velocity match where the drag vanishes, and compare with (γ − 1)m_ec² plus the space-charge potential correction; after cooling confirm Δp/p ≈ 10⁻⁴ and sub-π mm·mrad emittance from Schottky width and emittance measurements.
units.failure: 電子束與反質子軌道之間有 1 mrad 夾角或螺線管場不直，等效相對速度大增，冷卻時間拉長數倍；收集極回收效率下降時真空壓力上升，又反過來增加反質子的殘氣散射損失。~A 1 mrad angle between electron and antiproton trajectories, or a crooked solenoid field, greatly increases the effective relative velocity and lengthens cooling several-fold; a drop in collector efficiency raises the vacuum pressure, which in turn increases residual-gas scattering losses of the antiprotons.
units.misconception: 電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。~Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout.

units.anchor: Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷~Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics
units.title: 微安培束流的強度與動量分散量測~Measuring intensity and momentum spread of a microampere beam
units.mechanism: AD 每循環只有 10⁷ 量級的反質子，平均電流低於一般直流電流變壓器的有效解析度，因此強度與動量分散主要靠縱向 Schottky 訊號量測：粒子隨機分佈在環上，在每個迴轉諧波 n·f₀ 附近產生雜訊帶，帶的功率正比於粒子數，寬度正比於動量分散。由頻寬換算 Δp/p 需要滑相因子 η，而 η 取決於晶格的動量壓縮因子，必須以獨立量測校正，否則所有冷卻效果的評估都帶有系統誤差。~With only about 10⁷ antiprotons per cycle, the AD's mean current is below the useful resolution of ordinary DC current transformers, so intensity and momentum spread are measured mainly from longitudinal Schottky signals: particles randomly distributed around the ring create noise bands near each revolution harmonic n·f₀, whose power is proportional to particle number and whose width is proportional to momentum spread. Converting width to Δp/p needs the slip factor η, which depends on the lattice momentum compaction and must be calibrated independently, or every assessment of cooling carries a systematic error.
units.model: 平均電流等於粒子數乘電荷乘迴轉頻率。3×10⁷ 顆在 100 MeV/c（f₀ = 0.174 MHz）：I = N·e·f₀ = 3×10⁷×1.602×10⁻¹⁹×1.742×10⁵ ≈ 0.84 µA；在 3.57 GeV/c（f₀ = 1.59 MHz）約 7.6 µA。Schottky 帶寬 Δf = n·f₀·|η|·Δp/p，假設 |η| ≈ 0.95、n = 10、Δp/p = 1×10⁻⁴：Δf ≈ 10×174 200×0.95×10⁻⁴ ≈ 165 Hz，頻譜分析儀可清楚解析。~Mean current is particle number times charge times revolution frequency. For 3×10⁷ particles at 100 MeV/c (f₀ = 0.174 MHz), I = N·e·f₀ = 3×10⁷×1.602×10⁻¹⁹×1.742×10⁵ ≈ 0.84 µA; at 3.57 GeV/c (f₀ = 1.59 MHz) it is about 7.6 µA. The Schottky band width is Δf = n·f₀·|η|·Δp/p; assuming |η| ≈ 0.95, n = 10 and Δp/p = 1×10⁻⁴, Δf ≈ 10×174 200×0.95×10⁻⁴ ≈ 165 Hz, easily resolved by a spectrum analyser.
units.verify: 以已知強度的質子或 H⁻ 校正束在相同設定下比對 Schottky 功率與電流變壓器讀值，建立每粒子功率刻度；改變射頻頻率量測平均軌道位移求動量壓縮因子並計算 η；在多個諧波 n 量測同一束流，確認 Δf 與 n 成正比。~Cross-calibrate Schottky power against transformer readings with a proton or H⁻ calibration beam of known intensity under the same settings to establish power per particle; measure momentum compaction from orbit shifts under RF-frequency steps and compute η; measure the same beam at several harmonics n to confirm that Δf scales with n.
units.failure: 前置放大器增益隨溫度漂移 1 dB 而未重新校正時，Schottky 推算的強度誤差約 26%，實驗端收到的數量與報告不符；諧波選得太高使相鄰雜訊帶重疊，寬度量測失真，冷卻效果被誤判。~If preamplifier gain drifts by 1 dB with temperature and is not recalibrated, Schottky-derived intensity errs by about 26% and experiments receive numbers that disagree with reports; choosing too high a harmonic makes adjacent bands overlap, distorting width measurements and misjudging cooling.
units.misconception: 一般的直流電流變壓器就能精確量出 AD 的反質子數。~An ordinary DC current transformer can accurately count the AD's antiprotons.

units.anchor: NEG 鍍膜與極高真空~NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum
units.title: 殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命~Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime
units.mechanism: 反質子速度越低，與殘氣分子的散射截面越大，停留在平台上的時間也越長，因此真空要求隨能量下降而急遽提高。AD 平均真空約 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr，ELENA 則要求約 3×10⁻¹² Torr 的極高真空：真空室以低導磁率不鏽鋼（如 316LN）製作並可烘烤至 300 °C，廣泛採用 NEG（非蒸散型吸氣劑）鍍膜提供分布式抽氣，每台偶極與每段直線段配置 NEG 與離子泵組合，並使用全金屬閥門與 ConFlat 接頭。此壓力下殘氣以氫為主，損失與發射度增長主要來自單次散射。~The slower the antiproton, the larger its scattering cross-section on residual gas and the longer it sits on a plateau, so vacuum requirements tighten sharply as energy falls. The AD averages about 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr, while ELENA needs extreme-high vacuum near 3×10⁻¹² Torr: chambers of low-permeability stainless steel such as 316LN bakeable to 300 °C, extensive NEG (non-evaporable getter) coating for distributed pumping, combined NEG and ion pumps at every dipole and straight section, and all-metal valves with ConFlat joints. At this pressure the residual gas is mostly hydrogen and losses and emittance growth come mainly from single scattering events.
units.model: 壽命 τ = 1/(n·σ·v)。100 keV 反質子 v = 0.0146c ≈ 4.4×10⁶ m/s；假設等效損失截面 σ = 1×10⁻²⁰ m²（教學假設）。3×10⁻¹² Torr 時 n = 9.7×10¹⁰ m⁻³：τ ≈ 1/(9.7×10¹⁰×10⁻²⁰×4.4×10⁶) ≈ 240 s；若只有 AD 的 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr（n = 1.3×10¹³ m⁻³），τ 只剩約 1.8 s，比冷卻平台還短。~Lifetime is τ = 1/(n·σ·v). A 100 keV antiproton moves at v = 0.0146c ≈ 4.4×10⁶ m/s; assume an effective loss cross-section σ = 1×10⁻²⁰ m² (teaching assumption). At 3×10⁻¹² Torr, n = 9.7×10¹⁰ m⁻³ and τ ≈ 1/(9.7×10¹⁰×10⁻²⁰×4.4×10⁶) ≈ 240 s; at the AD's 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr (n = 1.3×10¹³ m⁻³) τ shrinks to about 1.8 s, shorter than a cooling plateau.
units.verify: 烘烤與 NEG 活化後以殘氣分析儀量各氣體分壓，用極高真空規量總壓並與分布式抽氣計算比較；有束流時量測平台上反質子數隨時間的衰減求 τ，並與局部壓力讀值關聯；長期追蹤 NEG 飽和造成的壓力上升，訂定再活化週期。~After bake-out and NEG activation measure partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and total pressure with extreme-high-vacuum gauges, comparing with the distributed-pumping calculation; with beam, fit the decay of antiproton number on a plateau to obtain τ and correlate it with local pressure readings; track the long-term pressure rise from NEG saturation to set the reactivation interval.
units.failure: 某段真空室微漏或烘烤不完全，局部壓力升到 10⁻¹⁰ Torr 級，100 keV 平台壽命從數分鐘降到數秒，ELENA 送出的反質子數大減；NEG 反覆暴露大氣而失效時壓力緩慢上升，問題常被誤認為冷卻器或注入故障。~A small leak or incomplete bake-out lets local pressure reach the 10⁻¹⁰ Torr range, the 100 keV plateau lifetime falls from minutes to seconds and ELENA's output collapses; NEG degraded by repeated venting raises pressure slowly, and the problem is often misdiagnosed as a cooler or injection fault.
units.misconception: 反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。~Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime.

units.anchor: ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線~ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines
units.title: ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束~ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments
units.mechanism: 過去 AD 直接把 5.3 MeV 反質子送給實驗，實驗再以降能箔片把能量降到可捕捉的 keV 等級，絕大多數反質子在箔片中湮滅或散開。ELENA 是周長 30.4 m 的小型減速環，把動量由 100 MeV/c 降到 13.7 MeV/c（動能 5.3 MeV 到 100 keV），在中間平台與末端以電子冷卻縮小束流，再分成 4 個束團經靜電傳輸線送到不同實驗區；在 100 keV 時靜電偏轉元件輕巧且沒有磁滯。結果使可捕捉的反質子數增加 10 到 100 倍。~The AD used to deliver 5.3 MeV antiprotons directly and experiments slowed them to trappable keV energies with degrader foils, where most annihilated or scattered away. ELENA is a 30.4 m decelerator ring that lowers momentum from 100 MeV/c to 13.7 MeV/c (5.3 MeV to 100 keV kinetic energy), electron-cools the beam on an intermediate plateau and at the end, and splits it into 4 bunches sent through electrostatic transfer lines to different experimental zones; at 100 keV electrostatic deflectors are compact and free of hysteresis. The result is 10 to 100 times more trappable antiprotons.
units.model: 100 keV 反質子 Bρ = 3.3356×0.0137 ≈ 0.0457 T·m，半徑 1 m 磁偏轉只需 0.046 T；靜電偏轉電場 E = 2T/(q·r) = 2×100 kV/1 m = 200 kV/m，與粒子質量無關，故以 100 keV H⁻ 調好的靜電線，相同設定即可用於反質子。ELENA 每循環注入 3.0×10⁷、送出 1.8×10⁷（60%），4 束團各約 4.5×10⁶ 顆，引出發射度約 4 π mm·mrad、Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³。~A 100 keV antiproton has Bρ = 3.3356×0.0137 ≈ 0.0457 T·m, so a 1 m bending radius needs only 0.046 T; electrostatic bending needs E = 2T/(q·r) = 2×100 kV/1 m = 200 kV/m, independent of mass, so an electrostatic line tuned with 100 keV H⁻ works for antiprotons at the same settings. ELENA takes 3.0×10⁷ per cycle and delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%), about 4.5×10⁶ in each of 4 bunches, with extracted emittance near 4 π mm·mrad and Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³.
units.verify: 試運轉時以外部 100 keV H⁻／質子源平行於 AD 運轉調整 ELENA 與傳輸線；在每條線末端量測束團長度、發射度與每束團數量，並與實驗阱中實際捕獲數比較，求出從 ELENA 引出到阱內的傳輸效率。~During commissioning tune ELENA and its lines with an external 100 keV H⁻/proton source in parallel with AD operation; at the end of each line measure bunch length, emittance and particles per bunch, and compare with the number actually captured in the experiment's trap to obtain the transfer efficiency from ELENA extraction to trap.
units.failure: 傳輸線絕緣子表面帶電或電極高壓漂移 1%，100 keV 束流在數公尺外偏離數 mm，送到實驗端的束斑擴大而捕獲效率大降；四個束團的分配時序錯誤時，某一實驗區整個循環都沒有束流。~Charged insulator surfaces or a 1% drift in electrode high voltage deflect the 100 keV beam by millimetres over a few metres, enlarging the spot at the experiment and slashing capture efficiency; a timing error in distributing the four bunches leaves one experimental zone without beam for the whole cycle.
units.misconception: ELENA 只是再降低能量，並不會增加實驗可用的反質子數。~ELENA merely lowers the energy further and does not increase usable antiprotons.

units.anchor: 約 100 s 的 AD 循環~The roughly 100 s AD cycle
units.title: 效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接~Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff
units.mechanism: AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。循環時間約 100 至 110 s，主要由各平台冷卻時間決定；縮短冷卻會降低束流品質，延長則降低速率。交接紀錄需列出每個平台的強度、發射度、動量分散、循環時間與可用度，讓 ALPHA、AEgIS、ASACUSA、BASE、GBAR 等實驗共享同一份基準，才能把阱內數量的變化追溯到加速器端或實驗端。~The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency. The cycle lasts about 100 to 110 s, dominated by cooling time on the plateaus; shortening cooling degrades beam quality while lengthening it lowers the rate. The handoff record must list intensity, emittance, momentum spread, cycle time and availability for every plateau so that ALPHA, AEgIS, ASACUSA, BASE, GBAR and others share one baseline and changes in trapped numbers can be traced to the accelerator or the experiment.
units.model: 注入 AD 約 5×10⁷、AD 送出約 3×10⁷（60%）、ELENA 送出 1.8×10⁷（60%）。以 110 s 循環計，一天約 785 個循環，送出約 1.4×10¹⁰ 顆反質子。1 ng 反質子約 6.0×10¹⁴ 顆，以此速率需約 4.2×10⁴ 天（約 116 年），說明 AD 的產出只適合精密量測，不是生產反物質。~About 5×10⁷ are injected into the AD, about 3×10⁷ leave it (60%) and ELENA delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%). With a 110 s cycle there are about 785 cycles a day, delivering about 1.4×10¹⁰ antiprotons. One nanogram of antiprotons is about 6.0×10¹⁴ particles, which at this rate takes about 4.2×10⁴ days (about 116 years), showing that the AD's output suits precision measurement, not antimatter production.
units.verify: 每週比對加速器端各平台強度紀錄與實驗端捕獲數；把效率鏈的每個係數做成趨勢圖，任何係數掉出歷史範圍即觸發檢查；年度停機後以標準循環重新量測全鏈效率，並與前一年的基準比較。~Each week compare accelerator plateau intensities with experiment trapping counts; plot every coefficient of the efficiency chain as a trend and trigger an investigation whenever one leaves its historical band; after the annual shutdown re-measure the full chain on a standard cycle and compare with the previous year's baseline.
units.failure: 只看最終送出數而不記錄各平台數據時，某個平台的冷卻劣化會被另一處的偶然改善掩蓋，等產出下降時已無法定位；實驗端更換捕捉電極或降能結構卻未通知，效率下降會被錯怪為加速器問題。~Watching only final delivered numbers without plateau data lets cooling degradation on one plateau hide behind a chance improvement elsewhere, so when output falls the cause cannot be located; an unannounced change of trap electrodes or degrader at an experiment makes its efficiency loss look like an accelerator problem.
units.misconception: AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。~The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant.

example: 減速平台規劃練習：PS 送來的束團長 25 ns、全寬動量分散約 6%（教學假設）。縱向相空間面積守恆，束團旋轉把長度拉到 150 ns 時，理想 Δp/p = 25×6%/150 = 1%，實測約 1.5%，差額來自射頻非線性與絲化。隨機冷卻把 Δp/p 壓到約 0.07% 後才減速；若在 Δp 近似不變下直接從 3.57 減到 0.1 GeV/c，Δp/p 會放大 3.57/0.1 = 35.7 倍，由 0.07% 變成 2.5%，遠超出環的動量接受度，因此每個平台都要再冷卻。100 MeV/c 冷卻後 Δp/p ≈ 0.01%，非相對論近似 ΔT/T ≈ 2Δp/p，5.31 MeV 的動能分散約 2×10⁻⁴×5.31 MeV ≈ 1.1 keV；ELENA 在 100 keV 引出時 Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³，ΔT ≈ 2×2.5×10⁻³×100 keV = 0.5 keV。相較之下，以箔片把 5.3 MeV 直接降能時出口能譜寬達數百 keV，只有很小比例落在阱可捕捉的 keV 窗口。數值為教學假設，不代表實機設定。~Deceleration-plateau exercise: bunches from the PS are 25 ns long with a full momentum spread of about 6% (teaching assumption). Longitudinal phase-space area is conserved, so rotating the bunch to 150 ns ideally gives Δp/p = 25×6%/150 = 1%, while about 1.5% is measured, the difference coming from RF nonlinearity and filamentation. Stochastic cooling brings Δp/p to about 0.07% before deceleration; decelerating straight from 3.57 to 0.1 GeV/c with Δp roughly constant would multiply Δp/p by 3.57/0.1 = 35.7, from 0.07% to 2.5%, far beyond the ring's momentum acceptance, which is why every plateau cools again. After cooling at 100 MeV/c, Δp/p ≈ 0.01%; non-relativistically ΔT/T ≈ 2Δp/p, so the 5.31 MeV kinetic-energy spread is about 2×10⁻⁴×5.31 MeV ≈ 1.1 keV; ELENA extracts at 100 keV with Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³, giving ΔT ≈ 2×2.5×10⁻³×100 keV = 0.5 keV. By contrast, degrading 5.3 MeV directly in a foil produces an exit spectrum hundreds of keV wide, of which only a small fraction lands in the trappable keV window. Values are teaching assumptions, not machine settings.
history: 1980 年代 CERN 以反質子累積器支撐 SppS 對撞，並以 LEAR 低能反質子環服務低能實驗，1995 年在 LEAR 上首次合成 9 個反氫原子。LEAR 於 1996 年關閉後，CERN 把原反質子收集環改建為 AD，2000 年開始運轉，2002 年 ATHENA 與 ATRAP 大量產生冷反氫，2011 年 ALPHA 把反氫捕捉約 16 分鐘。ELENA 於 2016 年開始試運轉，LS2 之後成為所有 AD 實驗的送束環。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In the 1980s CERN's Antiproton Accumulator fed the SppS collider while the LEAR low-energy ring served low-energy experiments, and in 1995 the first nine antihydrogen atoms were made at LEAR. After LEAR closed in 1996, CERN rebuilt the former Antiproton Collector into the AD, which began operating in 2000; in 2002 ATHENA and ATRAP produced cold antihydrogen in large numbers, and in 2011 ALPHA held antihydrogen for about 16 minutes. ELENA began commissioning in 2016 and after LS2 became the delivery ring for all AD experiments. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
